title: ST fallback stack resolution uses gcom /instances/{stackID}
answers: How does the router resolve the single-tenant fallback host?
Why does the ST fallback return no error for an unknown stack ID?
How do I add/modify single-tenant fallback stack lookup?
Fallback request to wrong stack / 404 handling in router
body:
Symptom: single-tenant fallback previously only worked for one hardcoded stack ID (Play), so requests for any other stack's namespace never fell back.
Root cause: pkg/router/cloud_router.go:ProvideCloudRoutesLoaderFactory wired a stub resolveHost that special-cased stackID 35611 instead of doing a real lookup.
Fix pattern: resolveHost is implemented by calling GET {GrafanaComAPIURL}/instances/{stackID} with `Authorization: Bearer <GrafanaComSSOAPIToken>` and returning the response's `url` field (pkg/router/st_fallback.go:newGComURLResolver). A 404 from gcom returns ("", nil) — not an error — meaning "no fallback for this stack"; any other non-200 status or decode failure returns an error, which the caller must distinguish from "not found".
Constraints: requires `[grafana_com] api_url`/`sso_api_token` (GF_GRAFANA_COM_API_URL / GF_GRAFANA_COM_SSO_API_TOKEN) to be configured — same config enterprise's gcom client uses; fallback itself is only active when `[cloud_router] st_discovery_url` is set. Results are cached by the existing fallback cache in newSingleTenantFallback, so resolveHost must stay side-effect-free/idempotent per stackID.
applies: pkg/router cloud router / single-tenant fallback resolution of stack URLs via gcom

Requires GF_GRAFANA_COM_API_URL and GF_GRAFANA_COM_SSO_API_TOKEN configuration and cloud_router.st_discovery_url to be set for fallback activation. Results are cached by newSingleTenantFallback, so resolveHost must remain side-effect-free and idempotent per stackID. Applies when configuring or implementing ST fallback for stack namespace resolution.
